caption: The drawing depicts a small bag or pouch made of a pink fabric as its main material. The bag has a cylindrical shape, decorated with a yellowish ruffled trim along both circular ends. Over the surface of the pink fabric, there is a grayish net-like pattern that is evenly spaced, creating diamond shapes across the body of the bag. One end of the bag features a closure mechanism, likely a drawstring, made from the same yellowish material as the ruffled trim. The drawstring is tied in a bow, with two segments ending in decorative tassels. The overall composition is centered on the page, with the bag positioned diagonally from the upper left to the bottom right against a plain, light background. The drawing uses watercolor or ink for the colors and details.
title: Muff
